decisions.statement: An artist is found by the musicbrainz id on that artist's record.
An artist nothing here holds is named for the name musicbrainz gave.
A song is keyed by the musicbrainz id on that song's record.
Nothing here reaches the network or writes a page.
An artist the musicbrainz id finds nothing for is found by the slug that name makes.
A song is keyed by that id only where the song is the named artist's own.
A song of another artist under the same work is named, so no slug collides with it.
A song is keyed by its title as well, so a song filed under no id is found.

definition: the artists and songs already filed, read by what musicbrainz calls each
